novelty_basis: Left-permutable groupoids are studied (e.g. Stanovsky's surveys; Weber 2009 on commutativity identities), and the argument is the regular-representation idea (Cayley); no statement about anchored left-permutable magmas or their enumeration was found in one search (2026-10-18). Likely folklore in spirit; small.
proof_check: Lean 4 + Mathlib for the structural core (centralizer_eq, comp_eq, id_eq, leftPerm_assoc, leftPerm_comm, leftPerm_one_mul, leftPerm_mul_one; standard axioms only); the inverse construction is immediate (written proof proofs/paper/C06.md Theorem 7); counts agree for N <= 5 (EXP-C06-02)
statement:
On Z/N, a.b := (a - 1)*b and x*y := (x + 1).y are inverse bijections between anchored magmas satisfying
x(yz) = y(xz) and commutative monoid structures with identity 0. Hence the number of anchored left-permutable
magmas of size N is the number of labelled commutative monoids of order N with a fixed identity (OEIS A058156:
1, 2, 9, 94, 1486, ...).
title: Anchored left-permutable magmas are commutative monoids in disguise (counted by OEIS A058156)
